title: Inside a $1.55M Belton Lake LUXURY Home | 4 Acres, Guest House & Private Lake Access
description:
Discover one of the most rare luxury homes on Belton Lake! This stunning 4.35-acre estate offers true multigenerational living with a full guest house, private lake access, RV/boat storage, and incredible energy-efficient construction. If you’re searching for luxury homes in Belton, Texas, Belton Lake real estate, or multigenerational homes in Temple-Belton, this tour is for you.

Presented by The Home in Texas Team — Ali Thompson & McKenna Taggart, your local experts helping families buy and sell throughout Belton, Temple, Salado, Harker Heights, and Central Texas.

🏡 Property Highlights:
• 5 Bedrooms • 4.5 Bathrooms
• 3,900+ sq. ft. main home + 1,000 sq. ft. guest house
• Built in 2020 with ICF walls, spray foam insulation, paid-off solar + 4 Enphase batteries
• Private Belton Lake access
• RV/boat bay + additional covered RV pad
• Workshop with A/C and insulation
• Custom treehouse, fenced livestock area & gated entry

Whether you're relocating to Belton, looking for a luxury home near Lake Belton High School, or searching for a property perfect for multigenerational living in Central Texas, this home has it all.
